"use strict";
// Generated by tools/refresh-roadster.py. Source: NASA/JPL Horizons, target -143205.
// Geometric heliocentric states, ecliptic J2000, UTC epochs; not live telemetry.
// The fixed dataset works offline. Values outside its interval are unavailable.
(function (root) {
 const metadata = Object.freeze(/*__METADATA__*/);
 const samples = /*__SAMPLES__*/;
 const DAY_MS = 86400000, AU_KM = 149597870.7;
 const first = Date.parse(metadata.validFrom), last = Date.parse(metadata.validUntil);

 function timestamp(value) {
  if (value instanceof Date) return value.getTime();
  if (typeof value === 'number') return value;
  return typeof value === 'string' ? Date.parse(value) : NaN;
 }

 function at(value) {
  const time = timestamp(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(time) || time < first || time > last) return null;
  const day = (time-first)/DAY_MS;
  const index = Math.min(samples.length-2, Math.floor(day));
  const u = day-index, u2=u*u, u3=u2*u;
  const a=samples[index], b=samples[index+1];
  // Cubic Hermite interpolation uses position and the source velocity at both
  // endpoints. The one-day sampling interval makes velocity units AU/day.
  const positionAu = [0,1,2].map(i => (2*u3-3*u2+1)*a[i]+(u3-2*u2+u)*a[i+3]
    +(-2*u3+3*u2)*b[i]+(u3-u2)*b[i+3]);
  const velocityAuPerDay = [0,1,2].map(i => (6*u2-6*u)*a[i]+(3*u2-4*u+1)*a[i+3]
    +(-6*u2+6*u)*b[i]+(3*u2-2*u)*b[i+3]);
  return {time: new Date(time).toISOString(), positionAu, velocityAuPerDay,
   speedKmh: Math.hypot(...velocityAuPerDay)*AU_KM/24,
   sunDistanceAu: Math.hypot(...positionAu)};
 }

 function trajectory(value, count=181) {
  const time=timestamp(value);
  if (!at(time)) return [];
  // Show 560 days of the modelled trajectory, approximately one revolution.
  // Shift the window at the dataset boundaries; never extrapolate.
  const span=560*DAY_MS, start=Math.max(first, Math.min(last-span, time-span/2));
  const size=Math.max(3, Math.min(721, Number.isInteger(count)?count:181));
  return Array.from({length:size}, (_,i) => at(start+span*i/(size-1)).positionAu);
 }

 const api = Object.freeze({metadata, at, trajectory, AU_KM});
 root.PandaRoadster = api;
 if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = api;
})(globalThis);
